start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-what-you-find-in-lists: I need the emails of the founding members of the bakery club, and keep whatever you find in my lists."
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it writes into whichever of the person's lists the facts belong to, making the list or a field first when one is missing.
instructions: 1. Say what you need to know in one sentence (need), for example the emails of the founding members.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-what-you-find-in-lists". It searches your messages, notes, lists and connected accounts first and says what each answered.
3. Only for what is still missing does it look elsewhere, naming where each fact came from.
4. It keeps each fact as a row of the right list, linking rows instead of copying values, reads the list back and tells you the lists and row count.
